drafts.title: The Clash at the Crime Scene
drafts.reasoning: This scene captures the tension between Noel’s professionalism and Hank’s stern approach through dialogue that highlights both characters' distinct voices and motives.

dialogue.line: Alright, everyone, let's keep it together here.
You're doing well, kid. Just remember, we don't have time for chit-chat.
I'm not a kid, Captain. I know my stuff, but maybe you should chill out a bit?
And if you could just try to be less intimidating for Sierra? She's trying her best with the girl over there.
Intimidating? We’re in a goddamn emergency! Everyone needs to step up their game!
Yeah, except this isn’t about who gets the lollipop first.
Snacks? John, focus on the case, not your sugar intake.
Look, we all need to work together here. But I can only keep quiet so long before my blood pressure starts boiling.
